question: Should `@openclaw/fs-safe/durability` become a supported semver public subpath with the proposed strict and unsupported-platform outcomes?
rationale: This is a new security-sensitive public API surface, so implementation quality alone cannot determine whether its permanence and platform contract match the package’s intended scope.

options.title: Sponsor the public durability subpath
options.body: Accept the API direction after restoring unreleased release metadata and obtaining real-runtime proof of the documented outcomes.

options.title: Keep durability internal for now
options.body: Avoid exporting the new subpath until maintainers settle the permanent caller contract and Windows support policy.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Retain only the shared internal best-effort integration and defer new public pinned-directory receipts to a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the public durability subpath
recommendation.body: Accept the API direction after restoring unreleased release metadata and obtaining real-runtime proof of the documented outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: Authored the proposed public API and is best placed to explain its intended consumer contract while maintainers decide whether to sponsor it.
